_how_to_edit: Edit the goals below and commit. status is one of: done, progress, planned, idea. area is one of: delivery, capacity, influence. horizon is 30, 60 or 90. Goals show in the order listed.

goals.title: Cash ISA £12k cap survey
goals.detail: Report and slide delivered.
